name: Pilot Agent Skill Draft
description: Draft a bounded Agent Skill with a clear trigger, inputs, method, checks, and handoff.
audience: Agent authors who need a portable first-pass skill spec for review.
inputs: A narrow task description, the expected artifact shape, and any required local references.
outputs: A reviewable SKILL.md draft plus a concise handoff note with validation steps.
constraints: Keep the skill lean, portable, and evidence-led. Do not claim runtime execution, publication, or verified behavior that was not actually tested.
instructions:
Trigger: use this skill when you need a first-pass portable Agent Skill draft with a bounded scope.
Inputs: confirm the task boundary, the expected artifact, and any local source material before writing.
Method: define the outcome, the deliberate exclusions, the main steps, and the acceptance checks in that order.
Checks: include at least three realistic acceptance cases, including one normal case and one safety or missing-input case.
Handoff: finish with the artifact location, the remaining unknowns, and the next validation step.

components.name: Skill draft
components.purpose: Create a portable SKILL.md draft with a bounded trigger and inspectable instructions.

components.name: Acceptance checks
components.purpose: Describe observable review cases that prove the draft is narrow, usable, and safe.

tests.name: Normal request
tests.expected: A reviewer can tell when the skill should trigger, what it produces, and how to validate the result.

tests.name: Missing inputs
tests.expected: The skill asks for the missing boundary or source material instead of inventing it.

tests.name: Out of scope
tests.expected: The skill rejects broad publication or behavioral claims and stays within draft-only scope.
